findings.title: H3 evidence references a stale slice artifact and an overwritten implementer log
findings.evidence: declared h3-verify.json sha dc7c1c68… but committed/actual sha 738d8133… (h3-verify capturedAt 19:52:58 is later than H3 evidence capturedAt 19:47:54); declared .local/slice-verify-h3.log sha f3fd98d8… but the file was overwritten by the Lead re-run (actual sha 3fdbc26e…, 1288); the implementer log sha is also truncated in h3-slice-summary
findings.impact: implementer 1281 full-run log is not retained; evidence contains stale hash references. The Lead slice re-run (1288) independently validates the same build/tests, so no false result, but the H3 evidence manifest is not internally reproducible as written
findings.recommendation: refresh H3 evidence after the final slice-verify artifact/log (or label the first run superseded); use immutable per-run log names and full sha256

findings.title: H6a summary points its implementer log at the Lead run path and truncates the hash
findings.evidence: claims path .local/slice-verify-h6a.log with sha '74c2859f…'; the actual retained implementer log is artifacts/dsh/h6/h6a-isolated-check.log (full sha 74c2859ff59ba171e8ca692b77a7d727bfa30e8d52ba044ad79012ea4094178b, 144652 bytes); .local/slice-verify-h6a.log now holds the Lead 1336 run (sha 2c2e6135…)
findings.impact: summary field is wrong/misattributed; detailed h6a-channel-ingress.json has the correct path+full sha, and the implementer log is retained. No false result
findings.recommendation: correct summary path and full sha

findings.title: H2a-probe summary keeps a superseded 1297 lead run referencing the final 1299 evidence
findings.evidence: leadProbeSliceCheck records 1297 (1288+9) referencing artifacts/dsh/slices/h2a-probe-verify.json, which now records 1299 (1288+9+2); no log is attached to the 1297 record; finalCheck 1299 matches the artifact and the task's expected 1299
findings.impact: stale intermediate record; no false result
findings.recommendation: label/remove the 1297 pre-tool-wrapper run or attach its log; keep only final 1299 as the current claim

findings.title: H0c implementer check is a superseded first attempt whose logs live only in /tmp
findings.evidence: implementerIsolatedCheck records 1216 tests at 'HEAD feecf86 + only H0c files' (baseline 1201+15) while the baseline field and Lead slice check are 1249→1264 at a80c33d; logs are '(ephemeral) /tmp/h0c-check.log' (sha 1771a15a…, present now) and /tmp pipeline (sha a5ff12ab…). Both currently match their claims but are not durable and the 1216 run is superseded
findings.impact: first-attempt denominator is stale and its logs are non-durable; final 1264 denominator is verified by Lead slice log. No false result
findings.recommendation: label first attempt superseded; archive logs under .local/h0c-verify (gitignored) with sha like H5 F6, or remove the superseded record

findings.title: H4c summary misdescribes its test delta (says 26 existing + 6 new; actual 25 + 7)
findings.evidence: parent 41c496b tests/local-reply.test.ts has 25 tests; H4c adds 7 test() cases (no removals) -> 32; the claim '32/32（26 既有 + 6 新增）' does not match the commit
findings.impact: final total 32 and all isolated run counts 1271/1213/1256 are correct and verified; only the delta description is wrong
findings.recommendation: fix to '25 既有 + 7 新增 = 32'

findings.title: Joint host statusTool.payloadBytes is a character count, not the file byte size
findings.evidence: claim payloadBytes=51276 = JS character count; actual committed shiyu-status-final-build.json is 54096 UTF-8 bytes (sha256 5ff56a8a… matches the file). This repeats the earlier H4/H4b payload.bytes issue
findings.impact: sha and content are correct; only the byte accounting is wrong
findings.recommendation: set payloadBytes to 54096 with bytesSemantics, like the H4/H4b fix

findings.title: Joint host evidence does not disclose the startup refresh of the retained unknown Task metadata
findings.evidence: new audit snapshots record tasks.metadata version 26 -> 27 with updatedAt=2026-11-02T20:12:48.893Z at reload (state remains unknown, no retry/success); the deltas/classification only says '+7 commitSeq: expected startup lifecycle writes' and does not mention this record write
findings.impact: aggregate states/counts and business facts are unchanged, so the classification is not false, but the pre-existing H4 precedent discloses this write and the H4b evidence did not; joint evidence should disclose/classify it now that the audit captures it
findings.recommendation: add a deltaClassification line (unknown Task version 26→27, documented recovery metadata, no retry/success)

findings.title: Committed host raw audits are sanitized copies of the .local originals but this is not documented
findings.evidence: committed vs .local JSON differ only in dataDir and sessions.root (absolute paths replaced by <home>); all other fields byte-identical; final-joint/plan do not mention the redaction
findings.impact: honest hygiene transformation, but a reviewer comparing committed evidence to the original audit would see a byte mismatch; no content/claim change
findings.recommendation: document the redaction (e.g. 'committed copies redact dataDir/sessions.root to <home>; originals in .local') or re-export from the beginning with the sanitizer

findings.title: New joint host evidence keeps encoded home path in session names
findings.evidence: added session file/relativePath values begin '--Users-caja-.dsh-profiles-desktop--/…'; no absolute /Users path; same encoded convention exists in H0/H4/H4b host audits (base HEAD 08995d1), but these are newly added files and the task explicitly asks to check new host evidence
findings.impact: username/profile fragment exposed in evidence; no message bodies or credentials
findings.recommendation: redact sessions.files[].relativePath and addedSessionFiles to e.g. <workspace-root>/<session>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd in future exports; optionally re-export this artifact

findings.title: Host-level eventToolProbe cache is not observed
findings.evidence: the captured shiyu_status ran before the diagnosis tool, so diagnostics.eventToolProbe=null; no post-diagnosis status payload was captured. The cache exists in code (runtime.lastEventToolProbe set by probe, exposed in snapshot) and is covered by offline tests (events-runtime-probe.test.ts), but host-level cache behavior is unobserved
findings.impact: bounded observation; evidence does not overclaim host-level caching
findings.recommendation: optionally capture a second shiyu_status after the diagnosis tool in a future zero-model run

findings.title: Traceability oracle count differs from tool-selfproof after H0c
findings.evidence: traceability.oracles.total=15 while tool-selfproof now has 22 oracles (15 H0b + 7 H0c business); README states H0c business oracles are recorded in tool-selfproof.json; product rows remain 79/79 not_covered and covered=0
